_doc: V31 source patch — plans, comparison, add-ons, notes (REPORT §425). Applied by scripts/i18n/v31/apply-source-patch.mjs. Each entry: ko/en new text + reason. Meaning checked against docs/SERVICE_CATALOG_V29.md; no entitlement broadened.

common:v29.pricing.basic.position.ko: 유학 방향을 정하고, 나에게 맞는 대학부터 고르고 싶은 학생
common:v29.pricing.basic.position.en: For students who want to choose a direction and the right universities first
common:v29.pricing.basic.position.why: en: 'set a direction' is a calque

common:v29.pricing.basic.f1.ko: 맞춤 유학 진단 상담 1회 + 후속 상담 1회
common:v29.pricing.basic.f1.en: A personal diagnostic consultation, plus 1 follow-up
common:v29.pricing.basic.f1.why: ko: count the first consultation too; en: noun stack

common:v29.pricing.basic.f2.en: Up to 3 recommended universities or language institutes

common:v29.pricing.basic.f3.en: Entry requirements, tuition and key dates side by side

common:v29.pricing.basic.f4.en: A checklist of the documents you need

common:v29.pricing.basic.f5.en: Visa steps explained for your nationality

common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.position.ko: 대학 지원과 입학 서류 준비까지 함께 받고 싶은 학생
common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.position.en: For students who want help applying and preparing their admission documents

common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f1.ko: 베이직 전체 포함 · 추천 대학 최대 5곳
common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f1.en: Everything in Basic · up to 5 recommended universities

common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f2.en: We manage up to 2 university applications with you
common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f2.why: en: 'managed' passive, unclear who does what

common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f3.en: Up to 2 editing rounds for your personal statement and study plan

common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f4.en: Document review, with notes on what to fix

common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f5.ko: 비자 신청 서류 준비 지원 · 기숙사 신청 일정 관리
common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f5.en: Help preparing your visa documents · dormitory deadlines tracked
common:v29.pricing.all_in_one.f5.why: MEANING: 'Visa documents prepared' implied Hangyul prepares them; contract = preparation SUPPORT (ko also ambiguous)

common:v29.pricing.premium.position.ko: 지원부터 비자, 입국 준비, 한국 초기 정착까지 함께하고 싶은 학생
common:v29.pricing.premium.position.en: For students who want help from application to visa, arrival and their first weeks in Korea

common:v29.pricing.premium.f1.ko: 올인원 전체 포함 · 추천 대학 최대 7곳
common:v29.pricing.premium.f1.en: Everything in All-in-One · up to 7 recommended universities

common:v29.pricing.premium.f2.ko: 대학 지원 최대 3곳 관리 · 모의 면접 1회
common:v29.pricing.premium.f2.en: We manage up to 3 applications with you · 1 mock interview

common:v29.pricing.premium.f3.ko: 계약한 지원 서류 첨삭 · 횟수 제한 없음
common:v29.pricing.premium.f3.en: No limit on editing rounds for the application documents in your contract
common:v29.pricing.premium.f3.why: en: keeps the scope boundary in the same sentence

common:v29.pricing.premium.f4.ko: 비자 서류·주요 일정 집중 관리 · 기숙사 신청 지원
common:v29.pricing.premium.f4.en: Visa documents and key dates closely managed · help with your dormitory application
common:v29.pricing.premium.f4.why: MEANING: 'Intensive visa scheduling' dropped the documents; contract = documents + key-schedule management

common:v29.pricing.premium.f5.ko: 입국 30일 전부터 정착 30일까지 · 전담 팀 우선 응대
common:v29.pricing.premium.f5.en: Support from 30 days before arrival to 30 days after · a dedicated team that replies first

common:v29.pricing.compare.row.support.why: MEANING: 'Consultation support' conflated the support WINDOW with the consultation SESSION

common:v29.pricing.compare.row.managed.why: MEANING: distinguishes MANAGED from RECOMMENDED; ko '대학 지원 관리' read as an activity, not a count

common:v29.pricing.compare.row.essay.en: Personal statement and study plan editing

common:v29.pricing.compare.value.documen.en: Review, with notes on what to fix
In-depth review, with notes on what to fix

common:v29.pricing.compare.value.visa.IN.en: Documents and key dates closely managed

common:v29.pricing.compare.value.dormito.en: Help applying, plus other housing options

common:v29.pricing.compare.value.settlem.en: From {{before}} days before arrival to {{count}} days after

common:v29.pricing.compare.scopeNote.ko: 프리미엄 첨삭은 계약한 지원 서류와 일정 안에서 횟수 제한이 없습니다. 새 서류 작성, 번역, 공증은 포함되지 않습니다.
common:v29.pricing.compare.scopeNote.en: Premium editing has no round limit for the application documents and schedule in your contract. Writing new documents, translation and notarization are not included.
common:v29.pricing.compare.scopeNote.why: MEANING: states the boundary where 'no limit' is said

common:v29.addon.item.extra_application.why: MEANING: it adds a managed APPLICATION, not 'management'

common:v29.addon.item.extra_edit.en: Extra edit: personal statement or study plan

common:v29.addon.item.airport_pickup.en: Airport pickup, arranged with a partner
common:v29.addon.item.airport_pickup.why: MEANING: Hangyul ARRANGES a partner; it does not operate transport

common:v29.pricing.addons.lede.ko: 필요할 때만 추가하세요. 담당 팀이 범위와 금액을 먼저 안내하고, 동의하신 뒤에 결제합니다.
common:v29.pricing.addons.lede.en: Add these only if you need them. Your team tells you the scope and the exact price first; you pay only after you agree.
common:v29.pricing.addons.lede.why: ko: '더하세요' unusual; en: 'the price' → exact price (a range is not a charge)

common:v29.pricing.notes.visaDecision.ko: 비자 지원은 서류 준비와 신청 절차를 돕는 서비스이며, 발급 여부는 출입국 당국이 결정합니다.
common:v29.pricing.notes.visaDecision.en: We help you prepare and apply. Whether a visa is issued is decided by the immigration authorities.
common:v29.pricing.notes.visaDecision.why: MEANING: visa SUPPORT ≠ visa DECISION, said plainly

common:v29.pricing.notes.agreement.ko: 세부 일정, 첨삭 범위, 답변 시간 등은 서비스 계약서나 주문서에서 정할 수 있습니다.
common:v29.pricing.notes.agreement.en: Details such as the schedule, editing scope and reply times can be set in your service agreement or order.
